evidence.quote: We measure beam smearing corrected molecular gas velocity dispersions and relate them to the molecular gas and star formation rate surface densities.

analysis_steps.goal: Match HST images to CO resolution

method.value: Convolve HST images with Gaussian of circularized ALMA beam, reproject to CO WCS, scale by pixel-scale ratio squared

evidence.quote: we scale the reprojected images by the squared ratio of the new pixel scale and old pixel scale to conserve flux.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure Sigma_*, Sigma_SFR and Sigma_mol in beam-sized apertures

method.value: Two offset grids of beam-sized circular apertures; stellar mass from F125W with color-based M/L; SFR from Halpha (Hao+11); Sigma_mol = alpha_CO R_J,J-1 I_CO

evidence.quote: we define a “grid” of circular, beam-sized apertures centered on the galaxy, and a second that is offset from the center by $0.5 \times$ the beam FWHM
and we impose a floor of $\mathrm{log} \, \Upsilon_{*,\mathrm{F125W}} = -1$.
SFR\;[M_{\odot}\,yr^{-1}]} = 5.53 \times 10^{-42} \times L_{\mathrm{H}\alpha}

assumptions.value: Constant alpha_CO = 4.35 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1, or variable alpha_CO from Bolatto+13 eq. 31 iterated until change <0.1%

evidence.quote: repeating this process until $\alpha_{\mathrm{CO}}$ changes by less than 0.1%.

method.value: Gaussian fit of central-pixel CO spectrum per aperture; subtract in quadrature model beam-smearing dispersion from arctan rotation-curve model cube smoothed to beam

evidence.quote: We perform our fitting using the Python SciPy function `curve_fit`.

findings_qualitative.value: DYNAMO galaxies are more gas-rich than local spirals at all disk positions and not analogous to local spiral centers

evidence.quote: DYNAMO galaxies are more gas-rich than local spirals (see Figure [3](#fig:ssd_gsd)) and are not analogous to the centers of local star-forming galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Are DYNAMO galaxies more gas-rich than local spirals on kpc scales?
claims.result: Sub-linear relation offset ~order of magnitude higher in Sigma_mol/Sigma_*
claims.finding: DYNAMO are globally more gas rich at all disk positions

evidence.quote: They are globally more gas rich at all positions in the disk.

claims.hypothesis: Does gravity+feedback transport theory reproduce sigma_mol?
claims.experiment: Compare data to Krumholz+18 for fiducial and varied t_orb

evidence.quote: we find that the gravity+feedback model overpredicts $\sigma_{\mathrm{mol}}$ when compared to our observations.

claims.experiment: Compare to TIGRESS, SILCC and feedback-only Krumholz+18
claims.finding: Feedback-regulated models reproduce observations without transport

evidence.quote: reproduce our observations without the need to invoke additional mechanisms for generating turbulence in the ISM such as gas transport or accretion.

why_this_data.value: DYNAMO galaxies resemble z~1-2 main-sequence systems but are nearby, allowing kpc-scale resolved study

evidence.quote: Their resemblance to high-redshift systems and proximity to us allows us to probe the turbulence powering mechanisms in gas-rich galaxies on kpc scales.

limitations_admitted.value: Literature comparison sample is heterogeneous and of differing data quality

evidence.quote: We offer the strong caveat that the sample is not homogeneously selected and there is a difference in data quality

referee_caveats_inferred: Only seven galaxies; beam smearing correction depends on assumed arctan models
Gaussian fit of central pixel spectrum may be affected by non-Gaussian profiles and S/N
Overlapping apertures make measurements non-independent for ODR errors
alpha_CO and extinction assumptions drive KS results
